observations: Manual sewing machine mounted on a treadle stand.
Black machine head with gold-colored decorative decals.
Metal frame stand with a large drive wheel and foot pedal.
A belt is visible connecting the drive wheel to the machine head.
The photo is low resolution and contains a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI'.

risks.risk: Mechanical parts may be seized or timing may be off.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine sewing through two layers of fabric.

risks.risk: Essential components like the bobbin case or shuttle may be missing.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the open bobbin area under the slide plate.

risks.risk: The wooden table or metal stand may be unstable or have hidden damage.
risks.proof: Photos of the underside of the table and the stand joints.

proof_requests: Clear, close-up photo of the brand name and logo on the machine head.
Video of the machine being operated (treadling and sewing).
Photo of the bobbin area and any included accessories (needles, bobbins).
response.reason: The item is clearly a manual treadle sewing machine. Although the brand is not legible, it can be priced as a generic model in non-working condition until proven otherwise.
